description: ACCDB protected by Database.NewPassword('', 'CalcDbProbe1'). Process A holds it open shared read/write with the password. Process B opens it read-only shared with no password, with a wrong password and with the right one (each counted), then opens it shared read/write with the right password, updates one row and closes. A reads the row.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
